statement: Evaluation risk: no retrieved work reports retrieval-layer version-selection accuracy (fraction of top-k passages from the in-force version) for legal amendment retrieval. Prior et al. report only end-answer LLM-as-judge scores and no retrieval ranking metrics, so the idea's central claim about the retrieval-agnostic temporal component would be tested against no existing retrieval baseline for this task.

evidence.quote: what is retrieved (the correct timeframe) matters more than how it is retrieved (embeddings vs. table of contents)
